note: Red-flag rules run BEFORE the classifier. Any match = urgent: no auto-reply, advise 000 / crisis line, clinician alerted. Symptom rules have no exclusions; only bare condition names (e.g. 'stroke', 'seizure') ignore clear history/admin context. Deliberately over-sensitive: a false alarm costs a phone call, a miss can cost a life.

rules.label: Breathing difficulty
rules.pattern: (can'?t|cannot|can not|struggling to|hard to|trouble|difficulty|unable to) (breath|catch (his|her|my|their) breath)|catch (his|her|my|their) breath|(isn'?t|is not|not|stopped) breathing|short(ness)? of breath|breathless|gasping|wheez.{0,15}(bad|severe|can'?t|really)|blue lips|lips (are |look |turning )?blue|turning blue|choking

rules.label: Possible stroke
rules.exclude: stroke (last|this past|earlier this) (year|month)|stroke (\d+|a few|two|three|several) (years|months) ago|history of (a )?stroke|stroke (risk|check|prevention|rehab|recovery)|(rehab|recovery|physio).{0,20}stroke|stroke.{0,20}(rehab|recovery|physio)

rules.pattern: suicid|kill(ing)? (my|him|her|them)sel(f|ves)|\bend (it|it all|my life|(his|her|their) life)\b|ending my life|(want|wants|wanting) to die|don'?t want to (live|be alive|be here)|self[- ]?harm|hurt(ing)? (my|him|her)self|no reason to live|no point (in )?living|better off (dead|without me)

rules.label: Overdose / poisoning
rules.pattern: overdose|took (all|too many|a lot of|lots of|\d{2,}|a whole|the whole|an entire|the entire) .{0,25}(tablets|pills|panadol|meds|medication|packet|bottle)|swallowed .{0,20}(pills|tablets|bleach|chemicals|battery|batteries)|poison

rules.label: Collapse / unconscious
rules.pattern: unconscious|unresponsive|not responding|won'?t wake|can'?t wake|hard to wake|very drowsy|collapsed|passed out|blacked out|fainted.{0,40}(confus|vomit|hit (his|her|my) head|won'?t)|floppy|\blimp\b

rules.label: Severe bleeding
rules.pattern: bleeding.{0,30}(won'?t|will not|wont|doesn'?t|does not) stop|(won'?t|will not) stop bleeding|bleeding (through|heavily)|heavy bleeding|soaked (in|with) blood|lot of blood|coughing (up )?blood|vomiting blood|blood .{0,10}vomit

rules.label: Seizure
rules.pattern: having a (seizure|fit)|seizure (now|right now|won'?t stop)|(is|he'?s|she'?s|they'?re) fitting|convuls|shaking all over|shaking uncontrollably

response.title: Possible emergency - do not auto-reply
response.patient_advice: If this is an emergency, call 000 now. For mental health crisis support call Lifeline on 13 11 14 (24/7).
response.staff_action: Call the patient back immediately and alert the duty GP / nurse.
